newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were at a standstill near midday on Monday, market sources said.
Packer bids were scattered at $103.00 to $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, with most owners asking $106.00, they said. Owners priced cattle at $66.00 on a live basis.
Activity was light following last week's brisk business, which sold out most showlists at $104.00, with a few at $105.00, the sources said.
The showlist was seen near steady with last week's estimate of 88,000 head, they said.
